exhaustive_65536_plan_only.acceptance_scope: Full 65,536 operand-pair enumeration would still not prove all arbitrary machine/register/CFG states, general math reasoning, or autonomous program synthesis
exhaustive_65536_plan_only.branch_coverage_plan: Instrument PC=0 JZ_B, PC=2 JZ_T with zero/nonzero values, explicit PC=6 loop, PC=7 HALT; include off-distribution register snapshots for all eight PCs and both branch directions, with PC/flag correctness and 75-step bounds
exhaustive_65536_plan_only.counterexample_handling: Persist every failure with operands, full trace and hash; any failed/unhalted case blocks whole-arm unconditional correctness and champion promotion
exhaustive_65536_plan_only.teacher_forcing_leakage_plan: Cross-check train/validation controller state hashes, exclude known train pairs, create unseen combinations of PC, registers, and branch directions; report pretraining overlap as UNKNOWN until recovered

branch_probes.scope: Confirms zero/nonzero behavior for four selected PC0/PC2 states only; it is not proof over all branch/register states.

dataset.construction: Python random.Random(12043148), 4096 ordered draws using randrange(256) for each operand, followed by the 11x11 cross-product of edges [0,1,2,3,7,15,31,63,127,128,255]
dataset.four_bit_construction: all ordered pairs a,b in range(16)

interventions.causal_result: Both interventions degraded every arm/seed relative to its unmodified probe result.

independent_measured_results.promotion: No default or champion promotion authorized.

runtime_boundary.host: Python performs decoded-op dispatch, bit indexing, register routing, the 75-cycle loop, and supplies the fixed eight-instruction shift-and-add ROM.
runtime_boundary.neural: Frozen SharedRLTISA logits decode opcode, next PC, HALT, local arithmetic bits, and opcode meaning. The controller forward receives fixed ROM embeddings, four register tensors, and current PC; teacher next-PC and teacher opcode are not forward inputs.
runtime_boundary.oracle: The reference product a*b is computed after rollout for scoring and was not substituted into inference.

training.jointly_tuned_local_supervision: All 320 primitive truth-table rows were replayed.
training.source_pretraining: The earlier task-conditioned RLT checkpoint included MUL training.

independent_measured_results.selected_arm_gate: All registered selected-arm checks reproduced for seeds 11, 19, and 29.

limitations: The 4217 eight-bit evaluations contain only 4084 unique ordered pairs and are not exhaustive over 65536 pairs.
The operand list is reused across seeds, so the three seeds are not three independent datasets.
All 320 local primitive patterns were supervised; 320/320 is retention of a trained truth table, not novel Boolean-rule reasoning.
Controller training used teacher-generated fixed-ROM states and labels; this verification does not prove absence of train-state contamination.
The pretrained RLT already included multiplication supervision.
The Python host supplies the fixed program ROM, decoded-op dispatch, bit indexing, register routing, and iteration loop.
The branch probes cover four PC0/PC2 states, not all reachable or arbitrary machine states.
PASS applies only to the qualified jointly_tuned registered checks. frozen_shared seed19 remains excluded.
No general-reasoning, program-invention, exhaustive eight-bit, arbitrary-CFG, or champion-promotion claim is made.

The required follow-up is enumeration of index 0..65535 as a=floor(index/256), b=index mod 256, preferably in 64 shards of 1024 per jointly_tuned seed, retaining every failed or unhalted trace and separately expanding branch-state coverage.
